title: RHC Canon Intake Decision
description: Minimal repository-side sidecar decision record for Canon Intake (CI-02): one explicit human approve/reject decision for one CI-01 candidate. A decision is evidence of human intent only; it never means published, canon, reconciled, conflict-free, or runtime-applied, and it never mutates the referenced candidate's content or status (the candidate contract stays exactly extracted | classified; approved candidates also remain non-canon until a later promotion gate succeeds). Approval authority is explicitly human: AI may propose but never decide. Only a candidate currently represented as classified is decision-eligible; eligibility itself is enforced by scripts/validate_intake_decisions.py against the referenced CI-01 candidate batch, not by this schema. Grouping is a non-authoritative convenience label only: a grouped review is a container for multiple independent decisions, never one inherited outcome. Duplicate decision identity and more than one decision for the same candidate in one validated decision set fail closed; no durable cross-run idempotency storage, collision resolution, promotion route, SQL/runtime persistence, or canon mutation belongs to this contract (later Canon Intake gates and the existing Save Gateway).

decision_id.description: Stable, typed, set-unique decision identity: the prefix is always decision: followed by a lowercase slug. Stable identity is what makes deterministic duplicate/replay detection possible at the contract layer; a duplicate decision_id within one validated decision set fails closed.

candidate_id.description: Referenced CI-01 candidate identity, using the exact intake_candidate.schema.json grammar: candidate: followed by a lowercase slug. The decision references and never rewrites or stores the candidate; source/provenance truth stays attached through the referenced candidate.

outcome.description: The explicit human decision outcome: exactly approved or rejected. Both outcomes are equally non-canon: an approved candidate is not published, reconciled, or runtime-applied, and a rejected candidate remains non-canon and cannot be treated as truth.

authority.description: Explicit human authority marker: exactly human. No AI or automated inference may approve or reject a candidate; AI may propose material, never decide it.

decided_by.description: Required non-blank reference to the human authority who made this decision (for example the Dungeon Master or another named human). Blank or whitespace-only references are rejected so a decision can never silently lack an accountable human identity.

note.description: Optional non-blank human note/reason for the decision.

batch_label.description: Optional non-blank, non-authoritative grouping/batch label for human review convenience. A group is only a container for multiple independent decisions: it inherits no outcome, imposes no uniform outcome, and mixed approved/rejected outcomes in one labeled group are legal.
